# TiLex 0.2.1

相比 0.1.2 的改动。

**升级方法与注意事项**：直接运行新安装包。出现「已安装」页面时，保持默认的「安装前卸载」，点下一步即可。安装包会识别旧版（0.1.x）并执行卸载。

**⚠️ 重要提醒：原有设置和生词本不会自动迁移保留**
- 0.2.1 是整体原生重写版本，数据存储目录已调整为 `%APPDATA%\TiLex`。旧版（0.1.x）的数据存放在旧目录中，新版**不会读取旧目录，也不会自动迁移**。升级后将是全新的默认配置与空白生词本。
- **旧版数据并未被删除**，仍完整保留在原处。如需保留原有生词本，**请务必在升级前使用 0.1.x 旧版导出 Markdown**（旧版设置页内提供导出功能），安装 0.2.1 后再根据需要重新录入。
- 新版安装包与卸载程序不会删除 `%APPDATA%\TiLex`，后续在 0.2.x 系列版本之间升级不会丢失数据。

## 架构与性能

- **Slint 原生重写**：整体从 Tauri + React 架构重写为 Rust + Slint 原生桌面架构，彻底摆脱对 WebView2 运行时的依赖，不再启动浏览器多进程。
- **内存大幅下降**：空闲内存（专用工作集）由旧版的约 149 MB（主进程与 9 个 WebView2 子进程合计）降低至原生版的 1.5–2.2 MB；日常使用翻译后的空闲专用工作集仅约 10–13 MB。
- **专注 Windows 体验**：正式取消 macOS 支持，专注打磨 Windows 平台的使用体验与性能。

## 功能对齐

新版与 0.1.x 核心功能范围保持一致（F1–F11），并未削减功能：
- **划词翻译与结果浮窗**：支持划词浮标取词、多服务并行翻译、结果折叠、复制、收藏生词与语音朗读（TTS）。
- **截图 OCR**：快捷键截图识别翻译，内置微信 OCR 与 Umi-OCR 离线/在线识别。
- **翻译服务**：支持自定义 AI 服务与模型（带测速与延迟统计），以及 Google、Bing、DeepL、百度、腾讯交互翻译等内置引擎。
- **生词本**：单词与长难句卡片、搜索与筛选、批量软删除与 Markdown 导出。
- **设置与系统集成**：系统托盘常驻、中英双语界面、深浅色主题切换、开机自启动及快捷键自定义。

# TiLex 0.2.1 (English)

Changes since 0.1.2.

**How to upgrade & Important notice**: Run the new installer directly. When the "Already Installed" page appears, keep the default "Uninstall before installing" and click Next. The installer will recognize and uninstall the legacy version (0.1.x).

**⚠️ Important Notice: Existing settings and wordbook are NOT automatically migrated**
- 0.2.1 is a complete native rewrite, and the data storage directory has changed to `%APPDATA%\TiLex`. Legacy (0.1.x) data resides in the old directory; the new version **does not read the old directory and will not automatically migrate it**. After upgrading, you will start with fresh default settings and an empty wordbook.
- **Legacy data has not been deleted** and remains intact in its original location. To keep your wordbook, **please export it to Markdown using the 0.1.x legacy version before upgrading** (available in the legacy Settings page), and re-enter words as needed after installing 0.2.1.
- The installer and uninstaller do not delete `%APPDATA%\TiLex`, so upgrading between future 0.2.x releases will preserve your data.

## Architecture & Performance

- **Native Slint Rewrite**: Fully rewritten from Tauri + React to native Rust + Slint. Completely removes the dependency on WebView2 runtime and no longer runs multiple browser processes.
- **Substantially Lower Memory Usage**: Idle memory (private working set) decreased from ~149 MB in the legacy version (main process combined with 9 WebView2 child processes) to 1.5–2.2 MB in the native rewrite; idle private working set after translation usage remains around 10–13 MB.
- **Focused on Windows**: Officially discontinued macOS support to focus entirely on the Windows desktop experience and performance.

## Feature Alignment

The new release aligns with all core features from 0.1.x (F1–F11) without feature reduction:
- **Selection & Result Popup**: Floating selection button, parallel multi-service translation, card folding, copying, word favoriting, and speech synthesis (TTS).
- **Screenshot OCR**: Hotkey screenshot capture and translation, supporting WeChat OCR and Umi-OCR offline/online recognition.
- **Translation Services**: Supports custom AI services/models with latency testing, plus built-in engines including Google, Bing, DeepL, Baidu, and Transmart.
- **Wordbook**: Word and sentence cards, search and filtering, batch removal, and Markdown export.
- **Settings & System Integration**: System tray residency, bilingual UI (English/Chinese), light/dark themes, launch at startup, and customizable hotkeys.
